definitions.explanation: Extremely heavy rainfall; rain falling in torrents.

examples.japanese: {土砂降|どしゃぶ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧だ。
{土砂降|どしゃぶ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}たなかった→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: My umbrella was useless in the downpour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧{土砂降|どしゃぶ}りになって⟦びしょ{濡|ぬ}れ→びしょ濡れ：16748_bishonure⟧になった。
examples.english: It suddenly started pouring and I got soaking wet.

notes:
Describes extremely heavy rainfall — a downpour.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{土砂|どしゃ}→土砂：17540_dosha⟧ (earth and sand) + {降|ふ}り (falling). Evokes rain so heavy it seems like earth and sand are falling from the sky.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {土砂降|どしゃぶ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: pouring rain
- {土砂降|どしゃぶ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to start pouring
- {土砂降|どしゃぶ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to get caught in a downpour

INTENSITY SCALE (rain):
⟦{小雨|こさめ}→小雨：05861_kosame⟧ (drizzle) → ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ (rain) → ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧ (heavy rain) → {土砂降|どしゃぶ}り (downpour) → ⟦{豪雨|ごうう}→豪雨：05860_gouu⟧ (torrential rain, often causing damage)
